messages:
alex: Heads-up — we need to lock in a retest window for the external pentest findings (SEC-4292, SEC-4293). Request: evidence export + RBAC changes in staging mirrors so testers can validate fixes. Can we aim for next Wed 09:00–13:00 PT?

maria-s: Wed morning works for me. Checklist idea: export artifacts, snapshot audit logs, create temp export role with expiry, run replay on staging, and run the retest playbook.

noah: Quick KMS question — what is the approved process for exporting encrypted logs? We want to avoid creating long-lived keys.

samir: For exports we use envelope encryption: generate a one-time DataKey via KMS, use it to symmetrically encrypt artifacts, upload to secure bucket, then KMS Destroy the DataKey (we only retain ciphertext). We can also sign a manifest with the key for integrity.

maria-s: +1. Steps I'll own: 1) create export role (expires in 48h), 2) export CloudTrail and our internal audit-log subset (30 days), 3) store artifacts in s3://sec-pt-exports/<run-id>/, 4) attach signed manifest.

julie: From product side — we need RBAC changes mirrored to staging: read-only tester role that can view sessions + traces but not rotate keys or change policies. Can infra produce a role template?

samir: I'll post a role template in a sec. It will be an ephemeral role: sts assume with 1h TTL, scoped to resources: logs:Read, traces:Read, s3:GetObject for the export bucket. No kms:Decrypt attached to the tester role. Decryption happens via a separate export job.

noah: That sounds good. One follow-up: will the export job create an audit trail showing who performed export and when?

maria-s: Yes — export job will log actor = "sec/export-service", include job-id and signed manifest. We'll also add an authorization tag with the JIRA ticket.

kevin: How does this affect capacity? If testers replay requests against staging we might need to pin capacity or throttle. We should coordinate with eng-oncall to avoid noisy alerts.

maria-s: Good point. Plan: set canary rate limit for replay traffic (max 10 rps per replica), and notify eng-oncall for a 4h window. I'll open an alert-snooze PR.

samir: Role template (example):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "tester_temp" {
  name = "pt-tester-${timestamp}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
  max_session_duration = 3600
}
# Policy: LogsRead + TracesRead + S3Get on s3://sec-pt-exports/<run-id>
```

maria-s: Tasks I assigned: 
- [ ] samir: create temp role + policy and post ARNs
- [ ] infra: run export job and upload artifacts to s3://sec-pt-exports/<run-id>/
- [ ] kevin: coordinate canary rate limits and oncall notification
- [ ] julie: validate tester role matrix and confirm no write perms
- [ ] alex: confirm retest window and authorize testers

devsec-ops-bot: Created task PT-EXPORT-1914 and PT-ROLE-1915 in Tracker: https://tracker.redwoodinference.com/browse/PT-EXPORT-1914

alex: I'm adding external tester list (email + gpg fingerprint) to the ticket and approving Wed 09:00–13:00 PT. Please call out any blockers by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria-s: If no blockers, I'll run the export Tue evening, create the role Wed 07:30 PT, and hand over access to testers at 08:45.

noah: One more: audit-log retention for the artifact snapshot — we should include request metadata and service-account impersonation history. I can add the fields to the manifest.

maria-s: Great — include: request_id, actor, assume_role_arn, job_id, signed_hash. That will make the retest evidence admissible for attestation.

kevin: I'll open a small infra ticket to pin a couple of extra replicas in staging during the window.

alex: Thanks, team. We'll reconvene after the export job completes. I'll mark this thread as the coordination anchor.
